description: This file serves as a command-line interface (CLI) for a project initialization tool called 'UniversalInit.' It handles argument parsing, project configuration creation, template generation, and execution of project setup routines. It supports commands to initialize various types of projects, retrieve specific commands for execution, and output the status and configuration details in JSON format.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Class representing the initialization info template for project setup.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Class holding configuration parameters for a project.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enum or class with method to convert string to project type.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating project templates and initializing projects.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig instance from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig to retrieve template info without full initialization.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a provided base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for init files.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints a JSON response indicating success or failure along with message and optional template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specific project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles CLI argument for retrieving the run command for a given project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point for the CLI tool; parses arguments and orchestrates project initialization or command retrieval.
